# Local media dependencies

`codecs.js` is generated by `node scripts/build-video-codecs.mjs` from the pinned lockfile in `tests/video-studio/`. It makes no network requests when used by Video Studio. The application passes only local File objects and project-generated samples.

- Mediabunny **1.56.2**, Mozilla Public License 2.0. Original source: <https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.56.2>. Package source: <https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.56.2.tgz>.
- SoundTouchJS **0.3.0**, GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1. Original source: <https://github.com/cutterbl/SoundTouchJS/tree/v0.3.0>. Package source: <https://registry.npmjs.org/soundtouchjs/-/soundtouchjs-0.3.0.tgz>.

Complete licenses are in `LICENSES.txt`. Both libraries are unmodified; the bundle selects exports and minifies them with esbuild. Corresponding source and the bundling entry point are available through the links above and this repository. Users may replace or rebuild these libraries; no technical restriction prevents modification or reverse engineering for debugging those changes. Each library remains under its own license.
